name: meet
stdout:
meet (greatest lower bound):  monad  ⊓  the_stone
  monad: ⟨𐑼𐑶𐑽𐑬𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑝⊙𐑓𐑳𐑷⟩
  the_stone: ⟨𐑦𐑸𐑾𐑹𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑠⊙𐑫𐑙𐑭⟩
  meet:   ⟨𐑼𐑶𐑽𐑬𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑝⊙𐑓𐑙𐑷⟩
  floor taken from monad on 7 slot(s), from the_stone on 1, equal on 4
  a meet DESCENDS: no slot rises. This is what the two share, not what they fuse to.
